description.text: The Gym Final (ジム☆ファイナル) was the district representative match of Japan's Official Pokémon Card Gyms from 2005 to 2007: seven tournaments each May, one per region from Hokkaido to Kyushu, for the store winners of that year's Gym Challenge. The winner of each league, junior, senior and master, won a gold Victory Medal and a place in the final tournament of that summer's Battle Road.
